title: Bowlbug (Rock)
move_pattern: Primarily uses Headbutt (16 damage). When off-balance, Headbutt triggers a self-stun that must be recovered with Dizzy, which resets the balance state.
notes: The monster's behavior is controlled by Imbalanced power, which tracks an 'off-balance' state. When off-balance and executing Headbutt, the monster stuns itself and must use Dizzy on the next turn to recover and reset the balance state.
